chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abu Nasr al-Bazanti. He said: I read in a letter of Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him):
Announce to my Shia that a visitation of me is considered by Allah, Mighty and Majestic, to be equal to one thousand Hajj pilgrimages.
He said: I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): One thousand Hajj? He said: Yes, by Allah, and one million Hajj for one who visits him recognizing his right.

key_terms.أَلْفَ أَلْفِ حَجَّةٍ: one million Hajj — an emphatic multiplication of the reward
key_terms.تَعْدِلُ: is equal to — denotes spiritual equivalence in divine reward
key_terms.زِيَارَتِي: a visitation of me — the act of pilgrimage to the Imam's shrine
key_terms.عَارِفًا بِحَقِّهِ: recognizing his right — visiting with knowledge of the Imam's divinely-appointed station and authority

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward of visiting Imam al-Rida's shrine according to the Imams?
ai.summary: In this narration, Imam al-Rida (AS) wrote in a letter to his followers that visiting his shrine equals a thousand Hajj pilgrimages in the sight of God. When the narrator al-Bazanti later mentioned this to Imam al-Jawad (AS), the Ninth Imam confirmed it with an oath and elevated the reward even further — to one million Hajj — for those who visit with true recognition of the Imam's divinely-appointed station. The condition of 'recognizing his right' emphasizes that the reward is tied to spiritual sincerity and doctrinal awareness, not mere physical presence.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan (rh) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Abi Nasr al-Bazanti He said: I read in a letter of Abi’l Hasan al-Rida (as):
Announce to my Shi`a that a visitation of me is considered by Allah to be equal to one thousand Hajj.
He said: I said to Abi Ja`far [al-Jawad] (as): One thousand Hajj? He said: Yes, by Allah. One million Hajj for one who visits him recognizing his right.
